title: Data sources
intro: ADMIN-managed connections to Jira Cloud projects Flow ingests. Each connection runs its own sync schedule.

field.siteUrlHint: https://<tenant>.atlassian.net — fixed once the connection is created

field.projectKeysHint: Jira project keys, uppercase (e.g. ENG, OPS)

test.failedGeneric: Test connection failed. Check your connection and try again.
